name: mandamistan
description: How Mamdani fixes the New York housing crisis, with receipts — measured against the real city. The crisis in sourced numbers, the Block by Block plan pillar by pillar (freeze + 200k built + 200k preserved + NYCHA + rezoning + tenant power), a promised-to-delivered timeline (the Oct 1 2026 rent freeze is live), the strongest critiques with their counters, a transparent what-if simulator — and, through the nyc module, a live scorecard that puts a measurable number next to every promise (rent burden, build pace, class-C violations per 1k renters, NYCHA, who builds nothing, lotteries open now), borough-grounded projections, and a home finder: income + household size → 2026 AMI band → affordable rent → lotteries and listings open to you today. Visual console + JSON API, stdlib only, every figure cited; degrades to a baked snapshot when nyc is away.
state: read-only cache of nyc answers in ~/.mod/mandamistan/cache; snapshot.json is the offline floor

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is
endpoints.GET /crisis: The NYC housing crisis in numbers, every figure sourced
endpoints.GET /plan: Block by Block: the whole plan, pillar by pillar
endpoints.GET /critiques: The strongest objections, and the counters
endpoints.GET /simulate: Project affordable stock + tenant savings (new_per_year, preserved_per_year, freeze_years, rgb_hike, attrition_per_year, median_stabilized_rent, years, base_pace, stabilized)
endpoints.GET /live: The crisis tiles with today's numbers via nyc (rent burden, median rent, renters, pipeline); HVS/shelter static
endpoints.GET /scorecard: Every pillar: promise → the metric that settles it → where it stands now, via nyc; stamped live|cache|stale|snapshot
endpoints.GET /borough: One borough's live profile + the simulator re-seeded to its share of the plan (name=Brooklyn|Bronx|Queens|Manhattan|Staten Island, plus any simulate arg)
endpoints.GET /find: A home for one household: income, household (1-8), bedrooms, borough → 2026 AMI band, affordable rent at 30%, lotteries open to that band, listings under the number
endpoints.GET /neighborhoods: Wealthy neighborhoods ranked by how little they built since 2020 (min_income, min_population, limit)
endpoints.GET /nyc: The dependency: is nyc reachable, and what are we serving from
